Messages.Author: John Flournoy
Messages.Body:


Black Hand is just a keyword; it's not tied to sect. (For instance,
see the rulings on the newsgroup about how merged Tariq is an
Independent Black Hand vampire.)

(Anarch is tied to sect, as it notes in the rulebook.)

-John Flournoy

Messages.Author: The Lasombra

On Sat, 24 May 2008 20:12:07 -0700 (PDT), bluedevil wrote:

>Deck Name : tariq blocks

http://bluedevilvtes.tripod.com/tariq_blocks.txt

Do you feel that the build you just posted is any stronger than the
original?

Deck Name : tariq blocks
Author :
Description :

The basic concept is Tariq becomes an anarch, gets atoned, then merges
to up his capacity back to 7+. Black Sunrise combines very nicely with
Atonement for serious blocking ability. The only rush in the deck is
Tariq's inherent; instead there are 8 Eagle's Sight. Having strong
eagle's ability means you can block anything you don't like on the
table. That includes things like rescues of your prey, votes you don't
like, votes to remove your anarch revolts, etc. For ousting it has
anarch revolts, many draughts, and four 1 caps to speed up the
bleeding a bit. The DotS also makes the Eagle's especially mean, since
it's easy to crank tariq up to 3+ permenant intercept. Of course,
anyone that looks block-fail-ish is a prime target for getting rushed.
Another strength of the deck is that Tariq is basically weapon combat,
and anarchs get Groundfighting, the best weapon booster ever. He's
also a cel/for vampire, and Diversion is another reason, almost enough
on its own, to go anarch.

About why there isn't a Smiling Jack in there.... it auto-screws the
whole table. Like Leandro, or Baltimore Purge. It's only rational for
you to start getting messed with cross-table, and I'd rather be just
another dec focusing on his prey and fending off his predator. If I
want, I can build up the Anarch Revolts on the table and let everybody
but my prey (yes, even my predator, maybe in return for some
concessions) go anarch. Then, when I'm close to ousting my prey, I can
"round the corner" early by taking out my grand-prey's anarchs. But I
generally don't want to build up any more cross-table fear and ire
than I absolutely must.
